description: Run a live Google search for a country, language and device and return the organic results in Google's order: position, title, URL, domain and snippet. Ads, sitelinks, video and image blocks are left out, so position is the organic rank. Every call is a real, uncached search that usually takes 2–3 seconds and is billed to the Serper.live balance per page of up to 10 results (https://serper.live/pricing). Use it to see the whole result list; to check where one site ranks, use domain_position instead.

country.description: Two-letter code of the market to search in, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE", "FR", "TR": Google sees a visitor from this country. Call list_countries for the markets that are open right now.

device.description: Browser persona Google sees. Desktop and mobile rankings often differ. Default: desktop.

language.description: Google interface language (hl), e.g. "en", "de", "fr", "uk". Defaults to the language of the country; the market itself is set by country.

limit.description: How many organic results to return, 1–100. Default: 10. Each started page of 10 results is billed.

query.description: Search keyword, exactly as a person would type it into Google.

name: google_search
title: Live Google search
